text: Hi Russia. I'd like a peaceful Galicia/Warsaw border. I plan Serbia and Rumania/Greece; can we keep Galicia empty and both aim at Turkey and others instead? Open to coordinating against Turkey later.
Hi Italy. I won't attack Venice if you stay out of Trieste and Tyrolia. Let's keep the border quiet; Turkey is the better target for both of us (Greece/Albania/Ionian).
Hi Turkey. I'm planning Serbia and then Greece. Happy to keep our border quiet if you stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria is shared peacefully. What are your plans?
Hi France. I propose we keep the Channel quiet and work together against Germany. I'll go north for Norway, and you can take Iberia and Belgium. Are you in?
Hi Germany. I'd like peace between us. I'm heading to Norway and have no plans on Kiel or Holland. Let's agree to keep the North Sea calm.
Hi Russia. I'm going for Norway, and I'd like you to stay out of Scandinavia beyond Sweden. Can we agree that? I'm happy to support you against Germany later.

Hi England. I'd like a peaceful Channel: I'll keep out of ENG and stay off your coast if you do the same. I plan to go Iberia and Belgium, and you can take Norway and Sweden. Want to coordinate against Germany later?
Hi Germany. I'm happy with a quiet border at Burgundy and Ruhr. I'm heading to Iberia this year. Let's pick a common target later, maybe England or Russia depending on how they move.
Hi Italy. I'll leave Piedmont and the Gulf of Lyon alone if you do the same. I'm going to Iberia and Belgium, so you can focus on Austria and Turkey. Does that work for you?

Hi France. I'd like a peaceful border and a joint push against England. I'll take Denmark and Holland, you take Belgium and Iberia. Then we can work together on England via the Channel and North Sea. Agree?
Hi Russia. I plan to keep Prussia and Silesia quiet if you do the same. Let's keep the Baltic calm so we can both expand, you south and me north. Okay?
Hi England. I'm going for Denmark this year and have no plans against you. Please keep out of Denmark, and let's talk about Scandinavia so we don't clash.
Hi Austria. I'd like a quiet border with you. I'll keep Venice defensive and won't go for Trieste if you stay out of Venice. Where do you see Turkey and Russia going?
Hi France. Want to work together? I'd leave you Piedmont and Marseilles alone, and we could look at Austria and Germany together later. Are you open to a quiet border?
Hello Turkey. I'm planning to keep the Ionian and Aegean calm, and I'd like us to be friends. If you're thinking about Austria or Russia, let me know and we can coordinate.
Hi Austria. I'd like peace between us in Galicia and the Balkans. I'm taking Rumania with my fleet, and I'll back you into Serbia and Greece afterward if you want to push against Turkey. Are you in?
Hello Germany. I'll keep Warsaw defensive toward you and Prussia quiet if you do the same. Happy to coordinate against England or France later. What are your plans?
Turkey, I'd like a quiet Black Sea between us. I'm heading for Rumania and won't attack Ankara or Armenia this year. Let's keep the border calm so we can both grow elsewhere.
Hi Russia. I'd like peace between us: no moves to Black Sea or Armenia from either side. I'll head west toward Bulgaria and Greece. Can we agree on that?
Italy, I'm happy to be friendly. I'd like to work together against Austria, with you taking Trieste and me going through the Balkans. Are you in?
I'm going to Bulgaria and I plan to leave Serbia and Greece for you if you stay out of Bulgaria. Please don't send anything there this spring.
Fine on Galicia staying empty. Russia takes Rumania, I take Serbia, then we look at Turkey together. Please don't send Warsaw to Galicia and I won't move there.
OK, I'll stay out of Bulgaria this spring. You stay out of Serbia, and I go there. Later we can talk about Greece.
Agreed: I stay out of Venice, you stay out of Trieste and Tyrolia. My fleet goes to Albania and my armies go to Serbia and Budapest, and nothing moves toward you.
Deal. Channel stays quiet, you take Iberia and Belgium, I go north. Later let's coordinate on Germany: your units into Burgundy/Ruhr, my fleets in the North Sea toward Holland and Denmark.
Fine, Denmark is yours this year. I'm only after Norway. Keep your fleet out of the North Sea and we're fine.
Sweden is yours if you stay out of Norway. If Germany grabs Denmark, we can both lean on them later.

Sounds good. I'll go MAO and Spain, staying out of the Channel. You take the north. Once Belgium and Iberia are settled we can look at Germany together, with your fleet in the North Sea and my army in Burgundy or Picardy.
Agreed on a quiet border. Take Denmark and Holland, I'll take Iberia and Belgium. I'll keep Paris home for now. Later we can talk about England together.
Yes, quiet border works. I won't touch Piedmont or the Gulf of Lyon. You'll do better pushing east against Austria and Turkey.
Thanks England. Fine on the North Sea, I stay out if you stay out of Kiel, Holland and Denmark. I take Denmark, you take Norway. Later we can talk about who gets Sweden.
Agreed on Prussia and Silesia staying quiet. I'm going north to Denmark, then Holland. Suggest you look south; I can help against France or England later.
Good, quiet Burgundy and Ruhr works for me. I'll keep Munich home. After Iberia and Belgium, let's plan England together: your fleet to the Channel, mine in Denmark and Holland toward the North Sea.

I'm in for Austria in principle, but I want to see Austria's setup first. This turn I'm keeping Venice solid and moving to the Ionian. If Austria opens toward you, I'll support the attack on Trieste next season. Please don't send your fleet into the Ionian.
Works for me. I'll stay out of Piedmont and the Gulf of Lyon, and I'm focusing east. Good luck in Iberia and Belgium.
Agreed on a quiet border: I won't go into Trieste or Tyrolia. I'll hold Venice and look at Tunisia and Greece. Please keep your units out of Venice and Piedmont.
Agreed on keeping Galicia empty. My fleet takes Rumania this spring. Please don't send anyone there, so we don't bounce. Serbia and Greece are yours, and we can go after Turkey together later.
Fine, no moves to the Black Sea or Armenia from me. Ankara holding is fine. I'm taking Rumania, so please stay clear of it.
Norway is yours and I'll stay out of the rest of Scandinavia except Sweden. Let's coordinate on Germany later.

Thanks Italy. Aegean and Ionian stay quiet from my side. Against Austria, you pressure Trieste via Venice and I take Bulgaria then Serbia and Greece. Next season we can coordinate supports. Are you in?
Agreed on a quiet Black Sea and Armenia. My fleet stays in Ankara. Good luck in Rumania, I'll take Bulgaria. Maybe we can both look at Austria later.
I'm taking Bulgaria this spring. Serbia and Greece are yours to fight over, and I won't contest them. Let's keep our border quiet.
